messages:
ravi: Heads up 1: several customers reported duplicated quota entries in the dashboard. Looks like different SDKs are emitting slightly different attribution headers so console is splitting.
jin: Which headers are we seeing?
ravi: Mix of: `x-redwood-ctx`, `X-Redwood-Context`, `rw_ctx`, and `billing_key`. casing + naming + structure variance.
lara: Oh no. TS middleware started sending a JSON `x-redwood-ctx` last week. Py still sends `rw_ctx=acct:org-7` style. Go inlines acct into token claim.
jin: That would create separate keys in console. Any quick reconciliation idea?
ravi: Two paths: 1) canonicalize at ingress (mutate headers) 2) canonicalize in Console (merge heuristics) 3) push SDK fixes. Ingress team prefer not to mutate.
lara: We should avoid console permanent merge heuristics because that hides root cause. But for immediate relief, console could implement a soft-merge layer for visualization only (not billing) and label merged groups as "Likely same tenant (heuristic)".
jin: I like soft-merge. It buys time while SDKs migrate. Also add a metric: percent of requests with canonical header to track migration.
ravi: SDK plan: TS -> keep JSON header but also emit `X-Redwood-Context` textual canonical header for compatibility; Py -> default to structured header but keep legacy in tandem until migration window ends; Go -> emit a small noop canonical header when inlining to token so console sees same shape.
lara: For TS middleware, we'll add a normalization step that writes `X-Redwood-Context: acct=org-7;route=feat` in addition to JSON. Should be harmless.
jin: We must be careful about header size & perf. Also ensure feature flags so we can roll back quickly.
ravi: Agreed. Each SDK change behind an opt-in env flag at first, then flip in 2 weeks once metrics show canonical header > 95% of traffic.
lara: Console changes: add a toggle above quota chart "Show merged attributions" with tooltip: "Soft-merge combines similar attribution headers for visualization; billing unaffected." Also surface a small status pill: "canonical header adoption: 32%".
infra-bot: deploy-plan: console soft-merge feature will canary 2026-04-10T22:00Z -> 5%/25%/100% with rollback on anomaly.
ravi: I'll coordinate release notes and a support playbook snippet: how to validate headers and when to escalate to SDK owners.
jin: I'll open PRs: TS PR for middleware (tests for mixed-case and both header shapes) and a Py PR to add structured header behind flag.
lara: I'll prototype the console soft-merge and metric card this week. Let's re-evaluate in standup in 48h.
jin: PRs created: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-ts/pull/512 and https://github.com/redwood/sdk-py/pull/221
ravi: Thanks. Action items: Jin (TS & Py PRs), Lara (Console prototyping + metric), Ravi (release note + support playbook). Follow up in #devex-standup.
